name: Tamra Lagoon Hut
description: A quiet, secluded sanctuary built from the repurposed timbers of the dismantled Kelpfang.
notes: Located in a peaceful southern lagoon. It houses the two active, humming Lingam stones (Heart and Voice), which are kept in a state of eternal balance to protect the surrounding coastal waters.
sources: Resonant Hearts: Intimate Chronicles Aboard the Kelpfang
